messages:
Sam: FYI started a canary for stricter fncall schema in eu-west. We're seeing a small but visible bump in rejects tied to the email-verifier tool. @Maria @Noah can you pull route mapping?
Maria: Pulled dashboard. Rejects spike at 10:03 UTC. Route IDs exist, but lots flagged with route_fallback=degen. Attaching a quick trace: https://redwood.internal/trace/tx-77
Noah: Trace shows adapter error: "schema_validation: expected object for attachments but got array". Sample from model: {"attachments":[{"name":"id.pdf","size":1024}]} but upstream expects {"attachments":{...}}
Linda: Two choices: widen schema to accept arrays OR coerce in gateway. Widening might mask bugs. Coercion keeps contract strict but adds magic.
Sam: Preference for coercion with explicit telemetry so we can spot upstream model issues. Also need to avoid billing double-counts if we replay calls.
Maria: Proposed plan: gateway adapter normalizes single-element attachments arrays into object, annotate event with telemetry tag coercion=attachments-array->object and header X-Coercion: gateway-v2. Also add a validator union for canary tests so we capture both shapes.
Noah: Implementation note: adapter should only coerce if array length==1 and content has keys matching object shape. Otherwise reject. I'll add unit tests. PR branch: fix/gateway-coerce-attachments.
Linda: Console UX: show a small badge on canary rollouts that surfaces coercion counts and sample trace links. I'll open ticket PLT-4821 and assign to @Console Team. Need a flag to mark coercion events as non-billable unless forwarded to the tool.
ops-bot: alert: fncall_reject_rate_eu-west = 0.37% (5m). Sampled traces captured (tx-77, tx-78).
Maria: For telemetry retention, keep coerced events at 7d and enable sampling=1 for first 100 occurrences from a customer to help debugging. Also add an alert if coercion > 0.2% over 15m.
Noah: Will add header X-Coercion-Source and a field meta.coercion_reason in telemetry payloads. Also ensure we set billing_flag=unbilled_for_normalization in routing policy for the replay step.
Sam: Great. Action items: Noah - adapter + tests + header; Maria - union schema for canary + sampling rule; Linda - console ticket + billing policy; Ops - monitor rejects and coercion metrics. We'll keep strict validation in prod after adapter lands.
Console Team: Acknowledged. We'll prototype the badge and add a filter in rollouts page to show coercion-tagged traces. Expect PR review in 2 days.
Sam: Thanks. Keep updates here. If coercion rate rises or we see >1% rejects, pause canary and revert to permissive routing.
Noah: PR opened: https://redwood.internal/pr/4444. Added tests and a small transformer module.
Maria: Updated canary test set and added schema sample cases. Running e2e now.
Linda: PLT-4821 created: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PLT-4821. Assigning to Console + Billing.
Sam: Closing the loop: once adapter is in, we will patch canary to re-enable strict reject (hard reject) and rely on telemetry to show remaining issues.
